item.title: The Gang Suppression Force in Haiti: A New Peacekeeping Template?
item.description:
Maya and Daniel unpack a November 2026 policy brief from the Global Initiative Against Transnational Organized Crime by Sophie Rutenbar examining Haiti's Gang Suppression Force. They explore why this hybrid, non-UN-led peace enforcement model was created, the logistical and strategic hurdles it faces, and what it reveals about the future of international interventions against powerful criminal groups.
